english.title: Operate relevant aircraft in contravention of article 92(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of

(C)_[a balloon]_
(D)_[a glider]_
(E)_[a kite]_
(F)_[parascending parachute]_
(G)_[an airship]_

which was

(H)_[launched]_
(I)_[moored]_
(J)_[tethered]_
(K)_[ground towed]_

and was operated

(L)_[in such a manner as to represent a hazard to other airspace users]_
(M)_[in such a manner as to, without the permission of the CAA, result in part of the relevant aircraft whilst it was being launched or towed extending more than 60 metres above ground level]_
(N)_[in such a manner as to, without the permission of the CAA, result in its tether, mooring or towing equipment, extending more than 60 metres above ground level]_
(O)_[within airspace]_
(P)_[within airspace notified for the purpose of article 92 of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
(Q)_[within the aerodrome traffic zone of a notified aerodrome, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..), during the notified operating hours of that aerodrome other than during the day in Visual Meteorological Conditions and with the permission of the person in charge of the aerodrome, the appropriate air traffic control unit or the CAA]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 92(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were the operator/pilot in command of a balloon/glider/kite/parascending parachute/airship
which was launched/moored/tethered/towed and was operated
in such a manner as to represent a hazard to other airspace users OR
in such a manner as to, without the permission of the CAA, result in part of the relevant aircraft whilst it was being launched or towed extending more than 60 metres above ground level OR
in such a manner as to, without the permission of the CAA, result in its tether, mooring or towing equipment, extending more than 60 metres above ground level OR
within airspace OR
within airspace notified for the purpose of article 92 OR
within the aerodrome traffic zone of a notified aerodrome during the notified operating hours of that aerodrome other than during the day in Visual Meteorological Conditions
and with the permission of the person in charge of the aerodrome, the appropriate air traffic control unit or the CAA
